content.comment_body: Hello, [company_name]. This is [user_name]. I have purchased a [product_name] with the following details: Order Number: [article_no] and Serial Number: S V-POBL 0640. Could you please confirm whether it is genuine or counterfeit? I have attached a photo of the device. Best regards.
This question was posted twice. Please refer to the topic: [product_name] Authenticity.

This thread has been closed since the same question was posted three times. The second discussion with the subject [product_name] Authenticity is available in the [product_name] - Hardware conference section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested support from [company_name] to verify the authenticity of a purchased [product_name] device by providing its order and serial numbers. The forum closed this discussion because of repeated posts and directed the user to another section. As a result, no direct verification or feedback about authenticity was provided, indicating there are currently limitations in the forum-based process for confirming product genuineness.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected to receive a clear and official response from [company_name] confirming whether their [product_name], as identified by order and serial numbers, is authentic.
